args.title: Saltmarsh Foods newsletter: Retail returns logistics — summary
args.body:
Summary of the latest Saltmarsh Foods newsletter, its linked article (https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns), and the companion piece (https://insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion):

- Apparel return rates have reached 24%.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (20%).
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
